programme.title: Ceasefire

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: President Bill Clinton on President Theodore Roosevelt Former President Bill Clinton reflects on the life and legacy of Theodore Roosevelt, America's 26th president (1901-09). His essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to mark America's 250th birthday in 2026.

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: A Conversation with George Washington and Ben Franklin George Washington (portrayed by Dan Shippey) and Ben Franklin (portrayed by Mark Skousen) talk about the 250th anniversary of American independence.

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: The Founders Debate the Constitution Stanford University constitutional scholar Jonathan Gienapp revisits the debates that engaged the Founders as they drafted the Constitution.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part One: 1869-1932 In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Two: 1933-1959 Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Three: 1960-1970 In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Four: 1969-1979 As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Five: 1980-1989 The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Six: 1990-1999 The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Friends and lovers try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships, sometimes misconstruing the true intentions of the opposite sex.

programme.title: The Heartbreak Kid
programme.desc: After his new bride reveals her nasty nature, a man (Ben Stiller) meets the woman (Michelle Monaghan) who may be his real soul mate and tries to woo her.

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Emily Brontë's Cathy (Juliette Binoche) and Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) fuel two generations of gothic romance on the Yorkshire moors.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past.

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: Labor Day
programme.desc: An escaped convict (Josh Brolin) convinces a lonely divorcee (Kate Winslet) and her adolescent son (Gattlin Griffith) to take him into their home.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Creamy Broccoli & Blue Cheese Gnocchi and Beef & Potato Pasties With inspiration to make everyday ingredients into feasts for less, Jamie shares his version of beef & potato pasties, a homemade gnocchi using leftover cheese, fish cakes made from the store cupboard and a retro dessert brought bang up to date.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Gnarly Celeriac Skewers and Cozy Tomato Soup Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
